comparison.objective: Clamp a lockout onto a selected breaker, close its lever, and padlock it.
comparison.physical_skill: Target selection, clamp placement, knob tightening, lever closure, and shackle insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Correct breaker remains OFF and the closed lockout resists specified pull and torque tests.
comparison.reason: Although both secure hardware, this record tests a compact clamp-and-padlock sequence; the candidate tests load-bearing rail registration across rack depth with paired spring prongs and prescribed screw holes. Candidate force limits are missing.
